title: conv3x3-engine-zynq: runtime-programmable 3x3 convolution engine and fixed Sobel core for Zynq-7020
description:
Artifacts for a runtime-programmable 3x3 convolution engine (AXI4-Stream data path, AXI4-Lite register file with 18 signed 8-bit coefficients) and a fixed Sobel reference core targeting the AMD/Xilinx XC7Z020-1: Verilog RTL, self-checking testbenches with randomized AXI4-Stream backpressure, a fixed-point golden model, Vivado 2026.1 out-of-context scripts, and post-route utilization, timing and power reports at 148.5 MHz for line widths of 160 and 1920 pixels. Simulation covers 160x120, 1920x16 and 1920x1080 frames, including full-rate input and mid-frame kernel rewrites.

Scope. The RTL is a reconstruction written from the design description after the original sources were lost. All hardware figures are post-route, out-of-context Vivado results; power is a vectorless estimate; no board-level runtime experiments were executed. At a 1920-pixel line width the engine meets the 148.5 MHz constraint only with the ExtraTimingOpt/AggressiveExplore implementation directives (default directives miss by 86 ps). The BSDS500 edge-quality evaluation (fixed point vs float64, 200 test images, relaxed matching) was re-implemented and is included, as is a script reproducing the DDR feasibility-model tables. See README.md for details.
